Distance is not measured in meters――デーヴ・グロスマンの「4つの距離」を分解する

「Zoomよりメールの方が値段交渉を強気にできる。これ、mechanical distanceでは？」。If we investigate this casual joke seriously, Dave Grossman's four distances stop looking like a simple law of psychology. They become a conceptual map of ways information needed to perceive another person as a full person can thin out. This essay checks cultural, moral, social, and mechanical distance against research on dehumanization, Bandura's moral disengagement, Milgram's proximity experiments, online disinhibition, and drone-operator psychology.
